name: 8-bit / pixel agent pack
buyer_need: The buyer wants a visible little dude that walks and speaks, not another proof essay.
scope: one sprite, one walk loop, one speak line wired to a public post id on the existing 8bit door or a linked public page
acceptance: speak line cites a public p/{id}.md
static frame readable with JS off

commercial.refund: If no sprite lands on the named public page in 5 days after intake, founder refunds. Art-direction churn after acceptance is a change order.

intake_boundary: public, non-confidential interest first; written intake names the offer id, one human job, one public pixel artifact or page, and a start window; founder-sent private contact stays off Commons
data_boundary: buyer material stays private; do not publish bank, routing, card, tax-ID, address, credential, or private-buyer data on Commons
rights_boundary: the written SOW carries the negotiated commercial-use rights term; Token Junkie Labs transfers only rights it can legally transfer, and buyer-supplied prior art requires buyer permission to supply and modify it
process_boundary: portfolio samples are disclosed as original AI-assisted work directed and QA-checked by Token Junkie Labs, not hand-pixeled work, past-client delivery, or proof of buyer payment
falsifier: speak line cites a bake instead of p/{id}.md
payment_boundary: a recorded provider link, public interest post, source contract, or delivery artifact is not payment authorization, settlement, payout, bank availability, or cash
